Name: Main Controller
Description: Main microcontroller for arm control and servo PWM generation.

Name: 5V Buck Converter
Description: Steps down input voltage to stable 5V for servos and MCU.

Name: Base Rotation Servo
Description: Servo for controlling the arm's base rotation.

Name: Shoulder Joint Servo
Description: Servo for controlling the shoulder joint's articulation.

Name: Elbow Joint Servo
Description: Servo for controlling the elbow joint's articulation.

Name: Wrist Joint Servo
Description: Servo for controlling the wrist joint's articulation.

Name: Gripper Servo
Description: Servo for opening and closing the end-effector gripper.

Name: Robot Arm Base Plate
Description: Base plate for the robot arm, providing a stable foundation.

Name: Lower Arm Link
Description: First link of the robot arm, connects to the base servo.

Name: Upper Arm Link
Description: Second link of the robot arm, connects two servos.

Name: Wrist Link
Description: Final link before the end effector.

Name: Base Servo Mount
Description: Mount for the base servo to attach to the base plate.

Name: Link Servo Mount
Description: Mount for attaching a servo to an arm link.

Name: Gripper End Effector
Description: Simple two-finger gripper for light object manipulation.

Name: Microcontroller Mount
Description: Mounting bracket for the ESP32 or Arduino Nano.
